data.one_liner: Converts already built widgets into skeleton loaders with a shimmer effect.
data.what_it_does: Skeletonizer reduces your existing layouts into skeletons and applies painting effects like a shimmer. It automatically handles widget shapes or lets you manually construct skeletons using specialized Bone widgets.
use_when: You want to display loading placeholders that automatically match your actual UI layouts.
You need custom shimmer bones for icons, text, and avatars with minimal boilerplate.
avoid_when: You are using complex custom painters that require explicit Skeleton.shade annotations and you cannot modify them.
strengths: Reduces duplicate work by turning existing UI layouts into skeletons automatically.
Provides fine-grained control via annotations like Skeleton.ignore, Skeleton.keep, and Skeleton.replace.
Supports manual layout building with specialized Bone widgets.
weaknesses: Requires fake data or mock models to render the layout structure correctly when enabled.
Network images and certain assets may throw errors if not replaced or conditionally disabled when skeletonization is active.
data.setup_notes: No native setup or build_runner required. Simply wrap widgets with Skeletonizer.

alternatives.name: shimmer
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a classic, standalone shimmer effect rather than automatically skeletonizing existing widget trees.
